title: Annual report.
bodyText: The board shall prepare an annual report on progress towards key community outcomes adopted by the legislature, which shall be transmitted to the governor, the legislature, and the public.
bodyHtml: [§27-53]  Annual report.  The board shall prepare an annual report on progress towards key community outcomes adopted by the legislature, which shall be transmitted to the governor, the legislature, and the public. [L 1999, c 160, §15]
